baseline.code_revision: five-ideas-development after the Phase 9F evidence-sufficiency gate
baseline.equivalence_test: The baseline calls unchanged Generator.generate with the selected QORE K=5 list; every diagnostic arm calls the same stable method and varies only an internal passage subset, markers, or order without changing selection inputs

core_invariants: Each question is retrieved and selected exactly once before any diagnostic output exists.
All arms use the same pinned model, deterministic decoding, evaluator normalization, and question.
Highlight markers are inserted only around lexical answer spans already present in passages.
Answer-first preserves selected passage membership and relative order within moved groups.
The Top-50 oracle contains only retrieved passages with an existing lexical answer match.
Probe outputs never feed back into retrieval, selection, generation, or labels.
The existing Generator, selector, evaluator, and stable answer matcher are not modified.
A fresh held-out validation slice is used and compact output contains no raw text.

interfaces.output_schema: one scalar arm record with attempted, EM, F1, and generation time
invariants: Uses the frozen Generator identity and deterministic decoding.
Raw prompt and prediction remain outside compact exchange output.

interfaces.input_schema: compact baseline, copy-control, and four context arm records
interfaces.output_schema: cohorts, arm summaries, exclusive attribution, paired bootstrap deltas, and report-only gate
invariants: Attribution is restricted to selected-hit baseline EM errors with successful copy control.
A dominant result authorizes no production change.

plugins.hypothesis: The unchanged generation arm is the reference.
Copy control separates output inability from context-use inability.
plugins.output_schema: conditional copy EM, F1, and time
plugins.resource_estimate: at most one generation per primary error

plugins.hypothesis: Complete answer-bearing selected passages contain useful context omitted by the Phase 9F local window.
plugins.input_schema: all answer-bearing selected passages in selected order
plugins.output_schema: plain full-passage EM, F1, and time
failure_signatures: probe includes a non-answer-bearing selected passage

plugins.hypothesis: Answer-span localization within complete answer-bearing passages is the obstruction.
plugins.input_schema: answer-bearing selected passages with internal lexical span markers
failure_signatures: marker adds text not present in source

plugins.hypothesis: Answer passage position or attention is the obstruction.
plugins.input_schema: all selected passages stably reordered by answer match
failure_signatures: reordering changes membership or within-group order

plugins.hypothesis: Additional answer-bearing Top-50 passages jointly provide missing evidence.
plugins.input_schema: all answer-bearing Top-50 passages in retrieval order
plugins.output_schema: Top-50 oracle EM, F1, and time

plugins.hypothesis: A weakest-success hierarchy separates within-passage context, localization, ordering, multi-passage, and residual failures.
plugins.output_schema: exclusive hierarchical attribution and report-only gate

composition.merge_rule: Retrieve/select once, run baseline, copy control only on selected-hit baseline EM failures, then all four paired context arms only after copy-control success; aggregate scalars only.
interaction_ablations: selected answer passages versus Top-50 answer oracle

validation.baseline_equivalence: Synthetic fixtures prove unchanged baseline Generator forwarding and deterministic diagnostic subsets/order.

reproducibility.dataset_identity: nq_open validation[750:800], Wiki-DPR psgs_w100.nq.compressed, nprobe=64, one Top-50 retrieval and one frozen QORE K=5 selection per question
reproducibility.environment: runner records Python executable/version, git revision, config SHA-256, plugin tree hash, resolved generator identity/config hash, retrieval/selection settings, and output paths

limitations: All context arms are oracle diagnostics and cannot support a production claim by themselves.
Lexical answer matching is not human-judged entailment.
The Top-50 oracle can be affected by the model input token limit.
A 50-question slice and deterministic decoding cannot establish broad generalization.
Every gate outcome is report-only and leaves production code unchanged.
